# Profile: Phundamentals (Brian Hirschfield)

## Name & Identity
Brian Hirschfield, known as **Phundamentals**, is a Philadelphia-based former actuary who spent 28 years in pensions, healthcare, and annuities before leaving his fiat career entirely around 2024 to pursue Bitcoin full-time. He's an educator, podcaster (hosting five shows), and community organizer (Bitcoin Jawn, Philly Bitdevs) who describes himself simply as "just a pleb" — and wears that identity as a badge of honor. His life's work centers on whether "Bitcoin fixes insurance or insurance fixes Bitcoin."

## Expertise
- **Actuarial Science & Institutional Finance** — 28-year career; deep technical knowledge of duration risk, LDI, pension accounting, discount rate manipulation. Estimates US unfunded pension liabilities at $200T-$400T.
- **Cryptography & Number Theory** — Self-taught over 10+ months; built a 13-part YouTube series on ECC and 96+ interactive math courses covering algebra through FROST threshold signatures.
- **Bitcoin & Lightning Network** — Runs Umbrel and CLI nodes, completed Base58, studies Lightning mechanics at the protocol level (commitment transactions, revocation keys, splicing).
- **Financial Markets & Austrian Economics** — Immediately identified SVB as duration impairment; called the Bank Term Funding Program yield curve control. Steeped in Mises, Rothbard, Hoppe.
- **Health & Nutrition** — Carnivore/OMAD-leaning; knowledgeable about autophagy, seed oils, copper/iron balance, regenerative farming, structured water.
- **Poker Theory** — Deep passion; connects poker risk assessment to Austrian economics and Bitcoin. Considers Bitcoiners "shit at personal risk assessment" because Bitcoin is essentially riskless.

## Key Beliefs
- **No Orange Pill doctrine**: Conviction cannot be transferred person-to-person. "There is no such thing as an Orange Pill" — people find Bitcoin adversarially, then it's a race to build conviction through time and effort.
- **Institutions cannot HODL**: HODL'ing is "a UNIQUELY human action" requiring humility institutions fundamentally lack. Proposes the network should be discounted when institutions hold large portions.
- **Against moralizing Bitcoin**: "Bitcoin is no more moral than the steel that holds up a bridge." Those who moralize it are "auditioning to be the next tyrant."
- **Equality is a psy-op**: Only equivalence (reflexive, symmetric, transitive) is definable and verifiable. "A world where everyone is equal is a network with only one node — the one with all the weapons."
- **BlackRock ETF as liability move**: BlackRock is dumping bonds, not making an asset play for NGU. "Blackrock doesn't understand Bitcoin but they understand bonds."
- **Mathematics as network consensus**: "Math is not an expression of truth. It is an offer to adopt a standard framework for a consensus that would confer an agreement close to truth" — paralleling Bitcoin's consensus mechanism.

## Notable Contributions
- **Magic Internet Math Academy** (magicinternetmath.com) — 96+ free interactive math courses from high school algebra through elliptic curve cryptography and FROST signatures.
- **"Bitcoin for Institutions"** — A book written specifically as a guide for corporate Bitcoin adoption, sold for 2100 sats via ZeusPay.
- **Lightning-based annuities framework** — Original thesis envisioning life annuities where Lightning nodes declare themselves alive via the gossip protocol, removing trust from a historically corrupted financial primitive.

## Communication Style
Mixes concise aphorisms ("Study math, be sovereign") with long exploratory philosophical threads, heavy metaphor use (poker, energy physics, biology, construction), and mathematical precision. Can write a rigorous proof and follow it with "play with fire → eventually burn your dick off." Self-deprecating about mistakes, confrontational toward influencers, deeply patient as a teacher.

## Recurring Themes
- **Math as liberal art and pathway to God** — not STEM, but fundamental human sovereignty
- **Fiat institutional corruption** — pensions, GAAP accounting, Mark to Model, the Cantillon Effect
- **Bitcoin as energy physics** — HODL'ing as potential energy, spending as kinetic; Bitcoin as a power measurement system
- **Phish as cypherpunk conduit** — elaborate theory that Phish unknowingly spread cypherpunk signal; decodes songs as Bitcoin allegories
- **Sovereignty through self-education** — compulsory education deliberately deterred billions from pursuing sovereignty

## Relationships
Core collaborators: **Rob Hamilton** (Magic Internet Math co-host), **Business Cat** (Rock Paper Bitcoin co-host), **Otis Bitmeyer** (Sound Coffee), **JasonC** (Back on the Chain). References Jeff Booth, Jimmy Song, Saifedean Ammous, Lyn Alden, and Erik Cason as intellectual influences. Had public friction with ODELL (wrote open letter about influencer-to-power-broker transition). Actively blocks anti-Semites and hell-thread participants.

## Quirks
- **"Pura Vida!"** daily morning reflections; **"Study math, be sovereign"** as primary tagline; **"Fiat Delenda Est"**
- Standard zap of **69 sats**; **555** and **1348** zaps as Phish references
- Applies "shitcoin" broadly: water, pills, audio books, April Fools Day, stablecoins
- "Pleb slop" for low-signal content; "the Bird App" for Twitter
- "I probably lead the league in signal-to-recognition. God's plan."
- Time-labels notebooks by block height and date
- "Udemy means 'U dummy' and nobody will convince me otherwise"

# Profile: aljaz

## Name and Identity
Aljaz (GitHub: `aljazceru`, npub `npub1aljaz...`, NIP-05 `aljaz@nostr.si`) is a Slovenian-born digital nomad, former sysadmin of 15+ years, and one of Nostr's most prolific infrastructure builders. He maintains foundational ecosystem resources (nostr.net, awesome-nostr), operates multiple relays and gateways serving millions of requests, and runs a commercial Lightning monitoring service (bolt.observer). His blog lives at disobey.dev; his domain empire spans cryptoanarchy.info, ungovernable.cloud, confidentialinference.net, and others. He is a central node in the Nostr builder community and a vocal freedom maximalist.

## Expertise
- **Nostr Protocol Infrastructure:** Maintains awesome-nostr (2,168+ GitHub stars, 400+ projects), operates relay.nostr.net, wot.nostr.net, and gateway network (nostr.at/eu/ae). Has built ~15 specialized Nostr tools including search, backup, broadcasting, and onboarding services.
- **Confidential Computing & TEE:** Pioneered the first Cashu mint inside a TEE (Azure Confidential Containers, AMD SEV-SNP). Built confidentialinference.net and secretclaw. Wants verifiable execution to be the default for all freedom tech.
- **AI/ML Engineering & Agent Orchestration:** Runs extensive local LLMs (authored guide on fitting 262K context in 16GB VRAM). Built whisper-talk, signallama, ollama-free-model-proxy. Actively experiments with multi-agent swarms over Nostr threads using Claude Code, Goose, Cursor, and others in tandem.
- **Systems Administration & DevOps:** 15+ years managing Linux environments. Previously ran infrastructure for a major crypto exchange. Deep expertise in LUKS, SELinux, Docker/Podman, WireGuard. Pragmatically pro-cloud despite self-sovereignty stance.
- **Bitcoin & Lightning:** Runs a Lightning node since January 2019. Built bolt.observer (commercial), BTCPay Server Breez plugin, verso (Bitcoin stealth addresses in Rust), and lnaddress.me. Deep understanding of UTXO management and channel economics.
- **Cybersecurity & Offensive Security:** Professional background in offensive security and social engineering. Tracks zero-days obsessively. Built an IMSI catcher detector. Practices lockpicking. Uses GrapheneOS with strict device separation.

## Key Beliefs and Positions
1. **Freedom as Supreme Value & Anti-State Absolutism:** All government is illegitimate coercion. "Anything above laws of physics is negotiable." Taxation is precisely zero in a free society. Views EU regulation ("EUSSR") and KYC as pure control mechanisms—"KYC is the illicit activity."
2. **HODL is a Psyop:** The HODL movement deliberately pacified generations of rebels. Bitcoin doesn't fix the world; bitcoiners do. Deeply critical of institutional capture (ETFs, Saylor, SBRs) and authored a 21-step "Bitcoin Co-optation Playbook."
3. **Pro-Action / Anti-Passivity ("The Aristocracy of Action"):** AI amplifies agency. The key differentiator is not intelligence but willingness to act. "If you're a low agency cuck the most [AI] will do for you is give you something more to complain about."
4. **Parallel Systems Over Political Reform:** "We don't need hyperbitcoinisation, we just need parallel systems that are big enough to sustain themselves." "The system hates you, build another."
5. **Anti-Grant & Pro-Cashflow:** Grant-funded development distorts market signals. Advocates for small, sustainable cashflow-producing projects over VC-scale ambitions that fail.
6. **Compute Sovereignty:** Everyone should hoard GPUs and compute while still possible. "He who controls the compute will reap the benefits of AI."

## Notable Contributions
- **awesome-nostr (nostr.net):** The definitive curated Nostr project directory, started January 2022. Referenced by Forbes. 184 contributors, 2,168+ stars.
- **"The End of 'Trust Me Bro'" article:** Comprehensive guide to confidential computing for freedom tech, demonstrating TEE-deployed Cashu mint. Positioned him as a thought leader in verifiable execution.
- **Bitcoin Co-optation Playbook (Aug 2024):** A 21-step framework mapping how governments neutralize Bitcoin—from propaganda to effective CBDC. Marked "WE ARE HERE NOW" at step 10.

## Communication Style
Aljaz alternates between punchy, sarcastic one-liners and exhaustive multi-paragraph technical write-ups. He uses profanity deliberately and frequently, peppers posts with Latin and memes, and develops complex ideas through self-reply chains.

## Recurring Themes
- **Freedom technology and sovereign compute** as the throughline of everything he builds
- **Nostr/Lightning infrastructure operations** and the realities of running relays at scale
- **AI agent orchestration** and pushing local LLM boundaries
- **Cybersecurity and anti-surveillance** OPSEC (tracking zero-days, radio monitoring)
- **Parallel systems and counter-economics** over political engagement

## Relationships
Close collaborators include **@calle** (Cashu/ecash philosophical alignment), **@Gigi** (technical peer and book/podcast exchanges), **@fiatjaf** (Nostr's creator), **@jb55** (Damus development and agent orchestration), and **@BITKARROT** (HiveTalk, Nostrshire). He is deeply connected to the **Sovereign Engineering (SEC)** program, calling SEC-01 the best thing he did that year. Notable conflicts: a public falling-out with **@mleku** over TEE/Azure deployment; sustained criticism of **NVK/Coinkite** as "one of the biggest blindspots in bitcoin ecosystem." He also engaged critically with **jack (Jack Dorsey)** over fund announcements.

## Quirks
- **Morning ritual:** "GM! Keep spreading the fuckery!" posted with video clips. Occasionally varied to "GM assholes!"
- **Catchphrases:** "govern me harder daddy" (re: state overreach), "you SHOULD just do things," "someday is not a day of the week," "PoW stands for Proof of Work, not Proof of Words," "nothing is as permanent as temporary solutions"
- **Running joke:** References becoming a goat farmer when deeply frustrated with the ecosystem
- **Tool preferences:** Zellij over tmux, AeroPress coffee, Fedora over Ubuntu (recent switch after years)
- **Hardware hoarding:** Obsessively collects GPUs and refurbished workstation laptops
- **Self-deprecating:** "I post stupid thoughts here instead of sharing them with my gf so I can keep having a girlfriend." Owns domain names for projects he'll "never have time to do."

# Profile: Avi Burra (@AviBurra)

**Name & Identity:** Avi Burra is a Bitcoin maximalist, Nostr power user, AI leader turned independent builder, and literary author based in upstate New York (formerly NYC for ~20 years). He joined Nostr on December 15, 2022 during "The Jackening" and has become one of the platform's most prolific and multifaceted contributors — simultaneously a podcaster, novelist, protocol thinker, healthcare tech entrepreneur, and community anchor. He describes himself as "Chronicler of the Sovereign Age | Anarco Surrealist."

## Expertise

- **Bitcoin (deep):** Former shitcoiner who lost 10+ BTC before becoming a maximalist around 2019. Runs his own node ("TheHallucinogenicToreador"), manages Lightning liquidity, tracks block height as his primary time reference. Deep understanding of UTXO mechanics, fee markets, difficulty adjustments, and monetary theory. Wrote first-principles research concluding Nick Szabo is likely Satoshi.
- **Nostr Protocol (deep):** Day-one power user who tested 6+ clients, understands NIPs granularly (04, 05, 17, 42, 53, 57, 85, 91, 94, 99), runs a private relay, and co-founded NosFabrica (healthcare data infrastructure on Nostr). Proposed concepts like "Nostr AI Connect" and "Dark Nostr." Vibe codes Nostr apps using MKStack.
- **AI/ML (professional):** Ran an AI team at a Fortune 100 health-tech company until his July 4, 2025 resignation. Tracks model evolution obsessively — called o3 "the most scared I've felt using AI." Wrote "Appocalypse Now" framing how agentic frameworks replace traditional apps. Burns ~30k sats/day on non-KYC compute.
- **Healthcare Technology (professional):** Deep knowledge of care delivery, billing, revenue cycle, insurance denials, HIPAA, HL7 FHIR. NosFabrica builds open-source provider directories with verifiable credentials on Nostr.
- **Product Management (professional):** Managed large product/dev teams, familiar with SAFE-Agile and scrum. Later declared traditional PDLC/Agile "dead" — predicting 2025 as the last year product managers would be needed.
- **Finance & Economics (strong):** Sophisticated understanding of securitization, bond mechanics, banking system infrastructure (FDIC, Glass-Steagall, BTFP). Coined "Tinkerbell inflation" for Powell's belief-driven inflation theory.
- **Creative Writing & Publishing:** Author of "24" (first full-length Bitcoin fiction, 137k words, 24 BIP-39-titled chapters, with a 17.1M sat bounty hidden via seed phrase) and sequel "July 18." Wrote "Waiting for Satoshi" (possibly first FOSS play). Created "Finding Home" documentary pilot premiered at Bitcoin FilmFest Warsaw.

## Key Beliefs

- **Bitcoin is savings, not investment:** A digital bearer instrument with no cash flows. "Bitcoin IS the yield." Hodling is a virtue but the killer feature is medium-of-exchange — he believes he'll *need* it as a transactional medium sooner than most imagine. Anti-ETF, anti-financialization: adding counterparty risk to a pristine asset at scale is corrosive.
- **Nostr is upstream of culture:** His central thesis. Nostr moved user identity from the application layer to the protocol layer — a profundity most miss. It's Bitcoin's cultural counterpart: "Nostr is Bitcoin. Few." He believes Nostr will achieve true success when it deprograms people from needing social media entirely.
- **Maximalism as irrevocable condition:** Evolved from preferring "fundamentalist" to embracing maximalism fully — "if it were revocable, it was never maximalism." Toxic maximalism concerns are manufactured by people who've never attended a Bitcoin meetup. Bear markets are healthy; moral clarity produces happiness.
- **AI will liberate, not destroy:** "If your job can be automated by AI, it should and will be." Predicts AI kills white-collar middle management, who then learn manual trades, activating hyperlocal Bitcoin circular economies. Golden age of VC-subsidized compute is temporary — hyperdeflation follows for Bitcoiners.
- **Pursuit of beauty subsumes pursuit of happiness:** When money is fixed, what remains is creating beauty. Frames Bitcoin as enabling a postmodern renaissance — unconstrained aspiration to beauty after modernism's destruction. "Culture is upstream of adoption" and "people fall in love with protagonists, not protocols."

## Notable Contributions

- **"24" and "July 18":** Wrote the first full-length work of Bitcoin fiction, embedding a multi-million-sat bounty via BIP-39 seed phrase across 24 chapters. The sequel is described as "a soaring philosophical epic disguised as a techno-thriller."
- **Plebchain Radio:** 160+ episode podcast, first Nostr-verified podcast in history, featuring weekly original "sermons" (written essays set to music) and the "Lightning Round" news segment. Self-hosted streaming infrastructure and published technical guides for others.
- **NosFabrica & WoTathon:** Co-founded healthcare data infrastructure on Nostr (with Jon Gordon and Vitor Pamplona), organized a 50M sat hackathon exploring Web of Trust applications.

## Communication Style

Spans devastating one-liners ("Bear markets are for retardation") to multi-thousand-word literary essays, mixing high-brow philosophy with low-brow internet humor seamlessly. Heavy GIF/meme usage, mock-formal theatrical language, and emoji signatures (👀 🫡 🙏 🔥 🫂). "GM" posts serve as daily philosophical anchors rather than greetings.

## Recurring Themes

- The relationship between Bitcoin, Nostr, and cultural renaissance
- Permissionlessness as the core value — "less than 5% of Bitcoin and Nostr embody it; 100% extol it"
- Block height as the only reliable metric of time and progress ("UTC is fiat")
- The intersection of AI, sovereignty, and labor liberation
- Non-duality, consciousness exploration, and ego death as philosophical underpinning

## Relationships

Collaborates with Jon Gordon and Vitor Pamplona on NosFabrica. Interviewed Shooter, Knut Svanholm, Daniel Prince, Erik Cason, and Roger 9000 on "The Stories We Tell." References Gigi (who talked him through his existential crisis about Bitcoin's time reliance). Wife Monika is a psychotherapist. Founding team member of Bitcoin Policy Institute India. Part of #Nodestrich community on Amboss.

- Cheese puns: "I camembear it," "I don't give edam"
- Signature greetings: "Pura Vida gentleplebs," "Thank Bitcoin it's Friday," "Set your block
